headline: Türkiye Unveils 2040 Energy Plan Targeting 175 GW in Solar and Wind
summary: Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar announced Türkiye's plan to reach 175,000 megawatts of installed wind and solar capacity by 2040, requiring an estimated $100 billion in investments and raising renewables to 77%.
why: Long-term national energy strategies outline capital expenditure requirements and renewable energy transition targets for utility and industrial sectors.
